question: Who won the Orange Cap for maximum runs in IPL-2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**K L Rahul**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **With 670 runs, KL Rahul **earns the **orange cap**. In IPL 2020, KL Rahul was the player of **Kings XI Punjab(Now Punjab Kings)**.
 
• The batter with the most runs in the tournament is awarded the **Orange Cap**.
 
• The top batsman in the event is given
